title: UPPJsonRpcMessage
description: JSON-RPC 2.0 message envelope for UPP protocol communication. Covers both request and response messages. All UPP operations are transported as JSON-RPC 2.0 messages over stdio, HTTP+SSE, or WebSocket transports.

Request.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 request message. The client sends this to invoke a UPP method on the server.

id.description: Unique request identifier. The server MUST include this same id in the response.

method.description: The UPP method to invoke. MUST use the 'upp/' prefix (e.g., 'upp/ingest', 'upp/retrieve', 'upp/events', 'upp/delete', 'upp/info', 'upp/labels', 'upp/export', 'upp/import').

params.description: Method-specific parameters. Structure depends on the method being called. See individual RPC schema files for parameter definitions.

Notification.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 notification (request without an id). The server MUST NOT respond to notifications.

method.description: The UPP method or event name.

SuccessResponse.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 success response. Returned when a request completes successfully.

id.description: Request identifier matching the original request.

result.description: Method-specific result data. Structure depends on the method that was called. See individual RPC schema files for result definitions.

ErrorResponse.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 error response. Returned when a request fails.

id.description: Request identifier matching the original request. May be null if the request id could not be determined.

code.description: Error code. Standard JSON-RPC codes (-32700 to -32603) and UPP-specific codes (-32001 to -32099).

message.description: A short, human-readable description of the error.

data.description: Additional structured data about the error. Implementation-specific.
